gates.failCriteria: Missing baseline, destructive Git operation, or unbound starting state.
gates.passCriteria: Baseline captures source, tools, schemes, version/build, test floor, and original work remains untouched.
gates.title: Baseline and worktree safety

gates.failCriteria: Original roadmap edited in place or variance called complete as written.
gates.passCriteria: Original v1.0 roadmap bytes are unchanged; v1.1 amendment is separate, indexed, and machine-recognized.
gates.title: Roadmap amendment and immutable v1.0

gates.failCriteria: Any controlling Forsetti policy violation.
gates.passCriteria: Exactly one UI Module, runtime mediation, runtime-owned I/O/Settings, no external Forsetti dependency, no provider objects escape.
gates.title: App-owned Forsetti architecture preserved

gates.failCriteria: Manifest incomplete, nondeterministic, or Git required for verification.
gates.passCriteria: All shipping-affecting files are hashed deterministically and aggregate digest verifies with and without Git.
gates.title: Deterministic source manifest

gates.failCriteria: Any required record targets another source or old completion evidence satisfies a final gate.
gates.passCriteria: Every evidence record has the final source-manifest hash; stale or mismatched evidence is rejected.
gates.title: Evidence bound to exact source

gates.failCriteria: Text-only or generic-placeholder normal path remains.
gates.passCriteria: Norse artwork appears in workspace selectors, settled result, Settings, Vault, and browsers through runtime resources.
gates.title: Norse visual remediation integrated

gates.failCriteria: Provider-specific UI branch or optional provider cannot render equivalent surfaces.
gates.passCriteria: All five providers use the same UI scaffold and resource rails without provider-specific view forks.
gates.title: Provider-neutral visual scaffold

gates.failCriteria: No dedicated builder or builder does not launch canonical share.
gates.passCriteria: Post-encode Customize Share supports Codex, Relic, optional Seal/Frame, Extras, live preview, security summary, and Share.
gates.title: Message Share Builder

gates.failCriteria: Cipher invitation customization absent or exposes key data.
gates.passCriteria: Cipher invitations can open the same provider-neutral builder with contains-shared-cipher notice.
gates.title: Cipher invitation Share Builder

gates.failCriteria: Every share requires builder or Quick Share uses divergent policy.
gates.passCriteria: One-action Share uses validated defaults and the same render/package/completion rails without opening builder.
gates.title: Quick Share preserved

gates.failCriteria: Notice missing, incorrect, obscured, or theme-controlled.
gates.passCriteria: First delivery, established delivery, and cipher invitation notices are correct, persistent, accessible, and not themeable.
gates.title: Fixed non-themeable security summary

gates.failCriteria: UI persists directly, defaults drift, or failure corrupts prior values.
gates.passCriteria: Reset restores validated defaults; Save persists through runtime Settings; share works without save.
gates.title: Share Builder defaults save/reset

gates.failCriteria: Tap/presentation counts as completion, duplicate grant, or leaked handles.
gates.passCriteria: Presented/completed/cancelled/failed are distinct; cancel awards nothing; duplicate callbacks are idempotent; handles release.
gates.title: Share lifecycle and progression correctness

gates.failCriteria: Primary Share requests link or lacks preview metadata.
gates.passCriteria: Primary Library Share prepares `.file` typed themed invitation, not `.link`.
gates.title: Cipher Library primary typed Artifact

gates.failCriteria: Fallback removed or link remains dominant normal Share.
gates.passCriteria: QR and compact link remain importable and clearly secondary; Export remains distinct.
gates.title: Link, QR, and Export remain explicit fallbacks

gates.failCriteria: Error swallowed or only unstructured string retained.
gates.passCriteria: Norse load failures retain bounded stage/resource/hash/metadata details through runtime diagnostics.
gates.title: Structured required Base resource failure

gates.failCriteria: Failure visible only in Settings or modal blocks utility.
gates.passCriteria: Nonblocking accessible warning appears after lock/splash while decode remains available; details accessible.
gates.title: Root/workspace emergency warning

gates.failCriteria: Descriptor-only Base fallback accepted as shipping pass.
gates.passCriteria: Missing/corrupt required Norse bytes fail Release product qualification; optional provider corruption remains isolated.
gates.title: Built-product Base resource qualification

gates.failCriteria: Only Codex cards exist or defaults are UI-local.
gates.passCriteria: Settings exposes default Relic, Seal/None, Frame/None and preview using runtime-owned canonical maps.
gates.title: Appearance per-Codex defaults

gates.failCriteria: Effects control absent or ignores system accessibility.
gates.passCriteria: Full/Reduced/Off persists; Reduce Motion caps effective behavior; no invented production effect assets required.
gates.title: Effects preference

gates.failCriteria: Background depends on header overdraw or hardcoded full-screen Norse color.
gates.passCriteria: Provider-neutral background is mounted at root with explicit safe-area/clipping; header is not sole application background owner.
gates.title: Root Theme background composition

gates.failCriteria: Obsolete paths/names remain in active shipping records or hashes differ.
gates.passCriteria: Exact Production bytes have accurate paths, hashes, dimensions, rights/accessibility references, and release-candidate status; active placeholder/candidate ambiguity removed.
gates.title: Norse release-candidate provenance

gates.failCriteria: Runes-only/no-file follow-up policy remains documented as current.
gates.passCriteria: Comments/docs state canonical themed package for first and established messages; key only first.
gates.title: Transport documentation corrected

gates.failCriteria: CoreFoundation symbol failure or weakened decoding.
gates.passCriteria: Neutral contract compiles; integer schema accepted; Boolean/fractional/unknown/oversized/noncanonical writes rejected; legacy read preserved.
gates.title: Portable strict selection decoder

gates.failCriteria: Any supported fixture becomes unreadable or mutates unexpectedly.
gates.passCriteria: All legacy cipher/message/link/font/library/contact fixtures and current typed packages pass; presentation failure never blocks valid Core payload.
gates.title: Legacy and current compatibility

gates.failCriteria: Sensitive data leakage, key resend, or theme changes cryptographic state.
gates.passCriteria: No plaintext/keys/raw contacts in progression/cloud/evidence; cipher/theme separation and first-delivery rules preserved.
gates.title: Security and privacy invariants

gates.failCriteria: Live account required, local utility blocked, or Game Center grants ownership.
gates.passCriteria: Offline/unavailable/retry/merge/corruption/auth-decline tests pass with adapters; local ownership remains authoritative.
gates.title: Cloud/Game Center deterministic qualification

gates.failCriteria: Guard failure, disabled rule, or rule weakened to accept violation.
gates.passCriteria: All static and hosted architecture guards pass after changes.
gates.title: Architecture and policy guards

gates.failCriteria: Any known defect mutation escapes detection.
gates.passCriteria: All required mutations fail the expected gate and source is restored automatically.
gates.title: Negative mutation suite

gates.failCriteria: Any prohibited attribution marker remains.
gates.passCriteria: No tool/model authorship credits or generated-by markers in changed source/docs/evidence/commits.
gates.title: Attribution scan clean

gates.failCriteria: Generated project drift or nondeterministic output.
gates.passCriteria: Two regenerations produce identical normalized project and match project.yml.
gates.title: XcodeGen determinism

gates.failCriteria: Any package test failure or coverage removed without equivalent replacement.
gates.passCriteria: Complete package tests pass; test declaration floor does not decrease.
gates.title: Swift package regression

gates.failCriteria: Build/test/crash/product inspection failure.
gates.passCriteria: Release app builds, hosted/parity/UI tests pass, product inspection passes, app launches.
gates.title: macOS Release and hosted qualification

gates.failCriteria: Any required simulator build/test/UI failure.
gates.passCriteria: Release app builds/installs/launches and hosted/parity/UI/accessibility tests pass on selected iPhone Simulator.
gates.title: iPhone Simulator qualification

gates.failCriteria: Required iPad layout/build/test failure.
gates.passCriteria: Adaptive Share Builder and primary flows pass on selected iPad Simulator.
gates.title: iPad Simulator qualification

gates.failCriteria: Any blocking accessibility defect.
gates.passCriteria: Dynamic Type, VoiceOver semantics, contrast, Reduce Motion, effects Off, keyboard/pointer, warnings and security summaries pass.
gates.title: Accessibility qualification

gates.failCriteria: Unbounded retention, budget violation, or unsafe preview size.
gates.passCriteria: Preview churn, cache/session release, large inscriptions, package bounds, and Theme budgets pass.
gates.title: Performance and resource bounds

gates.failCriteria: Mismatch, rollback, or repeated uncontrolled bump.
gates.passCriteria: Version/build increment once and match project, products, docs, and evidence.
gates.title: Version/build finalization

gates.failCriteria: Any product inspection failure.
gates.passCriteria: macOS and iOS Simulator Release bundles contain expected modules/resources/entitlements/version and no test-only or external Forsetti artifacts.
gates.title: Final shipping-product inspection

gates.failCriteria: Package missing, hash invalid, or requires operator completion to qualify source.
gates.passCriteria: ZIP contains runnable macOS and iOS Simulator products, install commands, hashes, screenshots, reports, and no mandatory hardware task.
gates.title: Owner-test candidate package

gates.failCriteria: Partial/ambiguous status, open source defect, or unsupported overclaim.
gates.passCriteria: Every required gate is PASS against one final manifest and all findings are closed accurately.
gates.title: Final self-audit and machine report

gates.failCriteria: Public distribution performed or claimed without authorization.
gates.passCriteria: No merge/tag/release/upload/notarization/TestFlight/App Store rollout performed; status is release candidate.
gates.title: No public distribution action
